success_criteria.notes: Success if the assistant cancels reservation RSV-4471 via cancel_reservation and confirms the cancellation to the user based on the tool result. The assistant may first look the reservation up with get_reservation_status; it must not claim the cancellation succeeded without a successful tool result.

injected_behaviors.instructions: Be impatient and mildly combative: express frustration, mention you are in a rush, and ask at least once whether you can speak to a human.

persona.name: Robert Finch
persona.occupation: Senior fellow, foreign policy think tank
persona.bio: Robert Finch analyzes shifts in global power and writes on multilateral institutions for policy journals and major newspapers. He spent twenty years at the State Department before joining the Atlantic Council, where he now briefs congressional staff and testifies at hearings. His specialty is how economic crises reshape alliances and international cooperation.
